lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa saas giraas na visarai se poore purakh paradhaan ||
lines.translation: Those who do not forget the Lord, with each and every breath and morsel of food, are the perfect and famous persons.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਗੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: karamee satigur paaeeai anadin lagai dhiaan ||
lines.translation: By His Grace they find the True Guru; night and day, they meditate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee sa(n)gat mil rahaa daragah paaee maan ||
lines.translation: I join the society of those persons, and in so doing, I am honored in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਉਦੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਉਠਦੇ ਭੀ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saude vaahu vaahu ucharahi uthade bhee vaahu karen ||
lines.translation: While asleep, they chant, "Waaho! Waaho!", and while awake, they chant, "Waaho!" as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਜਿ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਸੰਮਾਲੇਨਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak te mukh ujale j nit uth sa(n)maalen ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, radiant are the faces of those, who rise up early each day, and dwell upon the Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seveeai aapanaa paaeeai naam apaar ||
lines.translation: Serving his True Guru, one obtains the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉਜਲਿ ਡੁਬਦਿਆ ਕਢਿ ਲਏ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaujal dubadiaa kadh lae har daat kare daataar ||
lines.translation: The drowning person is lifted up and out of the terrifying world-ocean; the Great Giver gives the gift of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n se saah hai j naam karahi vaapaar ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed are those bankers who trade the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਸਿਖ ਆਵਦੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਘਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vanajaare sikh aavade sabad laghaavanahaar ||
lines.translation: The Sikhs, the traders come, and through the Word of His Shabad, they are carried across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭਈ ਤਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak jin kau kripaa bhaee tin seviaa sirajanahaar ||2||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, they alone serve the Creator Lord, who are blessed by His Grace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਭਗਤ ਹਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sache ke jan bhagat hahi sach sachaa jinee araadhiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who truly worship and adore the True Lord, are truly the humble devotees of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਧਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin guramukh khoj dha(n)dholiaa tin a(n)darahu hee sach laadhiaa ||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs who search and seek, find the True One within themselves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਾਧਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach saahib sach jinee seviaa kaal ka(n)tak maar tinee saadhiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who truly serve their True Lord and Master, overwhelm and conquer Death, the torturer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਲਾਧਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sachaa sabh doo vadaa hai sach sevan se sach ralaadhiaa ||
lines.translation: The True One is truly the greatest of all; those who serve the True One are blended with the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਨੋ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਫਲਾਧਿਆ ॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: sach sache no saabaas hai sach sachaa sev phalaadhiaa ||22||
lines.translation: Blessed and acclaimed is the Truest of the True; serving the Truest of the True, one blossoms forth in fruition. ||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮਹੀਣ ਭਰਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh praanee mugadh hai naamaheen bharamaai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is foolish; he wanders around without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur manooaa naa tikai phir phir joonee paai ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, his mind is not held steady, and he is reincarnated, over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har prabh aap daiaal hohi taa(n) satigur miliaa aai ||
lines.translation: But when the Lord God Himself becomes merciful to him, then the True Guru comes to meet him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam salaahi too janam maran dukh jaai ||1||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam; the pains of birth and death shall come to an end. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur saalaahee aapanaa bahu bidh ra(n)g subhaai ||
lines.translation: I praise my Guru in so many ways, with joyful love and affection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰਖਿਆ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur setee man rataa rakhiaa banat banaai ||
lines.translation: My mind is imbued with the True Guru; He has preserved the make of its making.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jihavaa saalaahi na rajaee har preetam chit laai ||
lines.translation: My tongue is not satisfied by praising Him; He has linked my consciousness with the Lord, my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naavai kee man bhukh hai man tripatai har ras khaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, my mind hungers for the Name of the Lord; my mind is satisfied, tasting the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਣਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sachaa kudarat jaaneeai din raatee jin banaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: The True Lord is truly known for His all-powerful creative nature; He fashioned the days and the nights.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: so sach salaahee sadaa sadaa sach sache keeaa vadiaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: I praise that True Lord, forever and ever; True is the glorious greatness of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saalaahee sach salaah sach sach keemat kinai na paaeeaa ||
lines.translation: True are the Praises of the Praiseworthy True Lord; the value of the True Lord cannot be appraised.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤਾ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa miliaa pooraa satiguroo taa haajar nadaree aaeeaa ||
lines.translation: When someone meets the Perfect True Guru, then His Sublime Presence comes to be seen.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਈਆ ॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: sach guramukh jinee salaahiaa tinaa bhukhaa sabh gavaaeeaa ||23||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs who praise the True Lord - all their hunger is gone. ||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਖੋਜੇਦਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਧਾ ਲੋੜਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai man tan khoj khojediaa so prabh ladhaa loR ||
lines.translation: Searching and examining my mind and body, I have found that God, whom I longed for.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਟੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਜੋੜਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: visat guroo mai paaiaa jin har prabh ditaa joR ||1||
lines.translation: I have found the Guru, the Divine Intermediary, who has united me with the Lord God. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਅਤਿ ਅੰਨਾ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaadhaaree at a(n)naa bolaa ||
lines.translation: One who is attached to Maya is totally blind and deaf.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਬਹੁ ਰੋਲ ਘਚੋਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad na sunaee bahu rol ghacholaa ||
lines.translation: He does not listen to the Word of the Shabad; he makes a great uproar and tumult.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jaapai sabad liv laai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs chant and meditate on the Shabad, and lovingly center their consciousness on it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam sun ma(n)ne har naam samaai ||
lines.translation: They hear and believe in the Name of the Lord; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaavai s kare karaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases God, He causes that to be done.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਜਦਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vajadaa ja(n)t vajaaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, human beings are the instruments which vibrate as God plays them. ||2||
